stem: During a transfer request, a lower-cost product is listed as interchangeable and reasonably available. Select all facts that matter before substitution.

choices.text: At this stage, determine whether the prescriber validly indicated no substitution.
Given the described event, confirm the product is listed as interchangeable under Massachusetts standards.
Under these facts, substitute any same-class drug without checking the list.
On this record, the substitute must be reasonably available at a lower retail price.
For this scenario, a valid prescriber direction against substitution prevents automatic interchange.
